QuestInfo.name: Native Help
QuestInfo.0: The master has returned to Momijigaoka and she has something important to tell you. Go to the main base and see Haruaki.
QuestInfo.1: You need to find powerful allies to fight against Oda and his army.\r\nThere's a town with human inhabitants to the south of Momijigahara. Check there first.
QuestInfo.2: You encountered Kino Konoko, the leader of the Mushroom Shrine. Maybe she knows something about the situation.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 6,402 Can proceed to the A Strange Encounter quest

0.0: Kanna! How's the new world treating you? You're looking a little...out of sorts. Have you not been eating your vegetables? How do you expect to rescue Princess Sakuno and defeat Oda Nobunaga if you don't eat your vegetables?
0.1: It's obvious that we don't have the strength to take on Nobunaga in a head-on battle. We don't even know where to find organic supplies around here. I don't think any of our soldiers are even getting five servings of vegetables. But Nobunaga's troops are so healthy. It's like they landed right on a garden or something.
0.2: If Oda's Army can get used to this place, we can too. Are you up for a little journey? You can travel the world, regain your strength, make some powerful allies, and find out how we can set up a produce supply route!

yes.0: Yes! You'll find a town with inhabitants to the south of Momijigahara. The enemy has most likely created a pathway to get to it.
yes.1: This mission is absolutely essential! Let me know when you're ready to depart.

no.0: Are you almost ready? No one here has juiced in days. I think I feel my skin flaking off!

1.0: Welcome to the Mushroom Shrine. How can I help you? Oh! Please don't step on that spot. I just swept it.

npc.0: Start by going down the hill to the east. Apparently there's a town with inhabitants to the south of #b#m807020100##k.The enemy scouts had to mark the location. It should be easy to find.
